name: Camiguin Hanging-Parrot
rangeDescription: Camiguin (philippines)
description: A very small parrot of upland forest on Camiguin island. Overall green in color with a bluish face, an orange bill and legs, and a red crown and rump.

name: Nilgiri Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Foothill forest of southwestern peninsular india (mysore southward to kerala)
description: Entirely indigo-blue male is unique; Verditer Flycatcher is brighter blue and more elongated. Female Nilgiri is gray overall, though can sometimes show a bluish tinge in good lighting.

name: Cryptic Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Submontane forest of mindanao (southern philippines)
description: A small bird of foothill and low-elevation montane forest on Mindanao. Dark brown above with a rufous tail, a white belly, a pale gray chest, and a buffy face and throat.

name: Southern Fulmar
rangeDescription: Antarctic circumpolar; ranges widely southern oceans
description: Distinctive, medium-sized silvery-gray petrel. Breeds around Antarctica, but regular migrant north to Chile, especially in winter.

name: Bushy-crested Hornbill
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar, malay peninsula, sumatra, borneo, and penang island
description: Plain, medium-sized dark hornbill. Glossy black with a bicolored tail and pale patches of bare facial skin.

name: Red-cheeked Wattle-eye
rangeDescription: Humid forest of guinea and southern sierra leone to southern cameroon
description: Tiny black-and-white rainforest wattle-eye. Both sexes have a chestnut patch on the side of the face and blue bare skin around the eye, though this eye wattle is larger in males.

name: Vinaceous-breasted Amazon
rangeDescription: Araucaria and broadleaf forest of eastern brazil (bahia) to eastern paraguay and northern argentina (rare)
description: Rare parrot, usually associated with Araucaria forests but can be found in other forest types. The body is mostly green with a small red patch on the forehead (just between the eyes), wings, and at the base of the outer tail feathers.

name: Yellow-eyed Pigeon
rangeDescription: Northeastern iran to siberia, northwestern india, and far western china
description: Nondescript brownish-gray pigeon with a bright yellow eye-ring. Wing pattern noticeably weaker than that of larger Hill Pigeons and wild-type Rock Doves.

name: Brown Firefinch
rangeDescription: Angola to democratic republic of the congo, zambia, southern tanzania, northern namibia, and northern zimbabwe
description: This is the darkest and dullest firefinch, the only species without a red or pink rump. Both sexes have red in the bill.

name: Pileated Parrot
rangeDescription: Humid forest of southeastern brazil to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Fairly small parrot usually seen in small groups or pairs in the canopy of humid forests, including Araucaria forests. The body is mostly green apart from a blue outer wing and tail feathers.

name: Flores Hawk-Eagle
rangeDescription: Lombok to alor (lesser sundas)
description: A large eagle with a bright white head and underside and a chocolate-brown back and uppertail. In flight, appears entirely white except for bold dark bars and tips on outer wings and tail.

name: White-bellied Tanager
rangeDescription: Coastal southeastern brazil (southern bahia to rio de janeiro)
description: Endemic to southeastern Brazil. Striking tanager found in the canopy in forest, edges, plantations, and gardens.

name: Mussau Triller
rangeDescription: Mussau, in st. matthias group (north-central bismarck archipelago)
description: A rather long-tailed and long-winged bird with a short stubby head, similar in proportions to a small cuckooshrike. Plumage distinctively clean-cut in black and white, with mostly black upperside and white underside, broad white wing panels, and a white rump barred black.

name: Scarlet Ibis
rangeDescription: Coastal colombia to trinidad, the guianas, and northeastern brazil
description: Unmistakable, beautiful orange-red ibis with black wingtips. Breeding adults have black bills, pink at other times.

name: Sula Pitta
rangeDescription: Peleng, in banggai islands and taliabu, seho, and mangole, in sula islands (off eastern sulawesi)
description: A spectacular ground-dwelling forest bird with a plump short-tailed body, extremely long legs, a bold red belly, a broad blue chest band, a reddish top to the black head, and green upperparts. Females yellow-eyed, males dark-eyed.

name: Barolo Shearwater
rangeDescription: Azores, desertas, salvage, and canary islands
description: Scarce and poorly known seabird breeding locally on islands of Azores, Madeira, and Canaries; very rarely seen at sea, usually as single birds, often not with other seabirds. Small, stiff-winged seabird that flies fast and low over the water (almost like an auk), gliding mainly in windy conditions.

name: Five-colored Munia
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas
description: A striking finch with a heavy silvery bill, a dark coppery hood, a brilliant white underside, and chestnut upperparts. Juveniles duller, with paler head and browner upperparts.

name: Jouanin's Petrel
rangeDescription: Northwestern indian ocean and southern arabian sea; breeding grounds unknown
description: An all-dark, pigeon-sized petrel. Very bulky, with broad wings and a heavy, dark bill.

name: Greater Melampitta
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed lower montane slopes of new guinea
description: A large, rare, ground bird from scattered areas of foothill and lower montane limestone forest. All black plumage with long legs, strong bill, long tail and some bare facial behind the eye.

name: Amsterdam Albatross
rangeDescription: Breeds amsterdam island (french subantarctic islands)
description: Extremely rare. A huge Wandering-type albatross that breeds only on Amsterdam Island in the southern Indian Ocean, with only a handful of records elsewhere (mainly Australia).
